title: Suzhou River (bc30)
synopsis: Set along the bustle of Shanghai's Suzhou River, Lou Ye's neo-noir thriller recalls the dark romance and fascinating mystery of Vertigo. The girlfriend of the film's unseen narrator, coy club performer Meimei attracts the attention of ex-con Mardar, who once loved and betrayed a girl named Moudan. Now out of jail, he searches restlessly for Moudan, and encounters her doppelganger in Meimei. An edgy, elusive mix of gritty realism and urban romanticism, Lou's breakout feature launched him to international renown. bc also welcomed a young Zhou Xun in person for the film that would define her career.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 速遞員馬達接下接載少女牡丹的工作，數次往復讓牡丹愛上馬達，但就在她決定交付真心時，馬達因貪念聯同黑道朋友綁架了她，令她心碎絕望跳進蘇州河裡。跳下前，牡丹留下會變成美人魚再尋馬達的遺言。五年後，為過往懊悔不已的馬達疑惑牡丹回來了，開始四處找尋。當在某酒吧裡看到扮美人魚表演的美美，馬達認定她就是牡丹……婁燁在此作確立成熟風格，以手持鏡頭帶領觀眾飄蕩於這條混濁卻又見證着都市繁華的蘇州河上，沉浮於世，細味情愛與生死。當時出道不久的周迅隨電影到 bc 分享，已嶄露鋒芒。
